grain: one row per Pokémon form × type slot (filter type_slot = Primary for one row per form)

schema.name: row_id
schema.label: Row id
schema.description: form_id + type slot (p/s); primary key

schema.name: type
schema.label: Type
schema.description: The type in this slot

schema.name: type_slot
schema.label: Type slot
schema.description: Filter to Primary for one row per form

schema.name: in_primary_slot
schema.label: In primary slot
schema.description: Pivot helper: sum() counts primary-slot rows

schema.name: in_secondary_slot
schema.label: In secondary slot
schema.description: Pivot helper: sum() counts secondary-slot rows

schema.name: form_id
schema.label: Form id
schema.description: One per source CSV row (800 forms)

schema.name: name
schema.label: Name
schema.description: Cleaned display name (form suffix split from species)

schema.name: form_kind
schema.label: Form kind
schema.description: Base = first CSV row for the dex number

schema.name: is_primary_form
schema.label: Base form
schema.description: True for the 721 first-listed forms (one per species)

schema.name: legendary
schema.label: Legendary
schema.description: Source flag; mythicals are flagged inconsistently

schema.name: phys_minus_spec
schema.label: Attack − Sp. Atk
schema.description: >0 physical lean, <0 special lean

schema.name: top_stat
schema.label: Highest stat
schema.description: Argmax of the six stats; ties go to the earlier stat in HP→Speed order

schema.name: total_legendary
schema.label: Total (legendary only)
schema.description: Pivot helper: total if legendary else null

schema.name: total_nonlegendary
schema.label: Total (non-legendary only)
schema.description: Pivot helper: total if not legendary else null

schema.name: has_mega_form
schema.label: Species has a Mega/Primal
schema.description: True on every form of a dex number that has a Mega/Primal

schema.name: mega_uplift
schema.label: Mega/Primal uplift
schema.description: Total minus base form total; Mega/Primal rows only

schema.name: offense
schema.label: Offense
schema.description: max(Attack, Sp. Atk): the better attacking stat

schema.name: bulk
schema.label: Bulk
schema.description: mean(HP, Defense, Sp. Def), 1 decimal

schema.name: glass_score
schema.label: Glass-cannon score
schema.description: z(offense) − z(bulk), z over the 721 base forms

schema.name: tank_score
schema.label: Tank score
schema.description: z(bulk) − max(z(offense), z(speed)), z over the 721 base forms

schema.name: is_glass_cannon
schema.label: Glass cannon
schema.description: glass_score ≥ 1.0 and z(offense) ≥ 0.5

schema.name: is_tank
schema.label: Tank
schema.description: tank_score ≥ 1.0 and z(bulk) ≥ 0.5

schema.name: archetype
schema.label: Archetype
schema.description: Glass cannon / Tank / Neither (mutually exclusive)

schema.name: in_team_pool
schema.label: Team-building pool
schema.description: Non-legendary and total ≥ 500 (analyst's definition)

schema.name: speed_lt60
schema.label: Speed <60
schema.description: Pivot helper: mean() gives the tier's share

schema.name: speed_60_79
schema.label: Speed 60–79
schema.description: Pivot helper: mean() gives the tier's share

schema.name: speed_80_99
schema.label: Speed 80–99
schema.description: Pivot helper: mean() gives the tier's share

schema.name: speed_100plus
schema.label: Speed 100+
schema.description: Pivot helper: mean() gives the tier's share

schema.name: total_mono
schema.label: Total (mono-type only)
schema.description: Pivot helper: total if mono-type else null

schema.name: total_dual
schema.label: Total (dual-type only)
schema.description: Pivot helper: total if dual-type else null
